propositions: Completion-verifier FAIL verdicts currently surface unmet criteria piecemeal across multiple cycles instead of enumerating all unmet criteria in a single verdict, forcing multiple remediation rounds.

The completion-verifier prompt must be updated to require exhaustive evaluation of every acceptance criterion independently and emit one finding per unmet criterion on FAIL, with explicit statement that incomplete verdicts (naming only a subset) are invalid.

A new deterministic scorer `enumerates_all_unmet_criteria` must be implemented, registered in eval_scorers.REGISTRY, and referenced in the eval spec with a two-criteria test case to prove the prompt achieves exhaustive finding enumeration.

The scorer must perform bijective matching of expected_unmet_criteria substrings to distinct findings' criterion fields; missing/empty annotation causes abstention (not applicable), consistent with existing scorers.
A FakeRunner unit test must verify that multi-finding FAIL verdicts survive reconcile_verdict and the close path with all findings intact, without changing reconcile_verdict logic itself.

The offline validation (validate_eval_spec strict=True + plumbing unit test in make test) gates the close; the live-LLM eval run in the [eval] pipeline is confirmatory behavioral proof, not a per-PR gate.
